style.policy: Use user-selected styleref1 for style only; printed old names/sizes/affinities and race-matrix labels never override current catalogs. Preserve original images.

presentation_policy.meaning: Generic visual design presentation, not assigned character gender; neutral does not infer a nonbinary identity.
presentation_policy.modesty: Practical covered clothing, non-sexualized anatomy; variation through face, hair, garment cut and restrained silhouette while preserving rig, volume and recognition.
presentation_policy.unknown_identity_gender: Remain null; no inference from name, portrait, pronouns or race.

rig.policy: Inherit fixed bones and animation registration; no per-frame resizing; preserve travel/aim split, contact and current timing; no gameplay mutation.

live_action_review.note: Distinct action semantics inherit jump row; no dedicated new clip claimed.
Live eligible wallrun silhouette overrides legacy alias to sprint; inspect wall contact, bank orientation and transitions.
Live jumpsquat_active silhouette and JumpPresentation anticipation; preserve duration and release.
Live airborne floating; finite allowance unchanged.
Only sylph/wyrmborn/angel/demon are flight capable in current catalog code; anatomy grants no new ability.
Live WALL_SKIM branch, not old wall_skim -> slide alias; wall contact and attachment review mandatory.

coverage_rule: Every matrix entry requires all rig directions x base rows, every walk and sprint travel x aim x phase, and every live_action_review case in all eight headings where applicable. Applicability must be explicit; flight is restricted to existing flight-capable races. Pending status means no claimed rendered or functional evidence.
